review:
Canny and Mona in a retro woodland on up to 7,776 ways, with the Drop mechanic. When the Drop symbol lands, it falls to the bottom after wins are paid, and everything above it trickles down.

Then all the empty spaces fill with one matching symbol that Canny picks at random – in the base game that can even be the wild. If it makes a win, it pays. Bonus rounds build on the same idea. Rated 4/5, 10,000x max, top RTP 96.21%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.10% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
